a.lede: What better way to celebrate Cybersecurity Awareness Month than warning that three-quarters of the web is about to be set on fire?
a.title: We shouldn't be surprised about the PHPocalypse, as the internet is built on sticks and glue

b.lede: Two critical bugs in the PHP web programming language, used by the majority of the internet, threatened to upend the internet — and it's unlikely to be the last major software scare.
b.title: PHP-ocalypse: How two critical web bugs almost broke the internet
